mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_document(title, source, tags, status, chunk_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{title}, #{source}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{createdBy}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, title, source, tags, status, chunk_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_document where status = #{status} order by updated_at desc, id desc
select id, title, source, tags, status, chunk_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_document where created_by = #{createdBy} order by updated_at desc, id desc
mapper.update: update knowledge_document set status = #{status}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
